description: This Java class 'DashboardImportService' handles importing and updating Dashboard entities within the Thingsboard platform, including ID replacement, entity lookup, and assignment to customers.

classes.name: DashboardImportService
classes.description: Service class for importing Dashboard entities, handling ID replacements, entity lookups, and customer assignments.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID for the dashboard entity.

methods.name: findExistingEntity
methods.description: Finds an existing dashboard by ID or name within the tenant.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the dashboard for import by replacing IDs in entity aliases and widget configs.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the dashboard, managing customer assignments accordingly.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a dashboard object.

methods.name: isUpdateNeeded
methods.description: Determines if an update is necessary based on configuration differences.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DASHBOARD.
